description: System architecture before the code exists: module boundaries, data schema, save format, network model, which engine features to lean on. Produces a technical design with its trade-offs, not an implementation.
when_to_use: a feature spans several systems and its shape is not settled
a data schema, save format or protocol has to be decided
there is a real choice between technical approaches
avoid_when: the change fits inside one existing system
the architecture is settled and the work is writing the code
